'''Leiran''' is an [[Aiel]] of the [[Cosaida]] sept of the [[Chareen]] clan. 

== Appearance ==
He is handsome, with a puckered white scar that runs under a black cloth which covers a missing eye.

== Activities ==
Leiran is a [[Sha'mad Conde|Thunder Walker]] and is ''[[siswai'aman]]''. He is sent with most of the other Aiel to the [[Plains of Maredo]] where [[Rand al'Thor]] plans to attack [[Sammael]] in [[Illian]]. He shows off in front of the [[Maidens of the Spear]], who think he has a good sense of humor, especially [[Enaila]].

Before her death in the [[Tarmon Gai'don|Last Battle]], Enaila laid down a [[bridal wreath]] at Leiran's feet. It is unknown if they ever had time to get married before Enaila's death, but probably unlikely.
